statement: A taxpayer other than a corporation may elect under § 1045 to recognize gain from the sale of qualified small business stock held more than 6 months only to the extent the amount realized exceeds the cost of qualified small business stock purchased during the 60-day period beginning on the date of sale; the unrecognized gain reduces, in the order acquired, the basis of the replacement stock (26 U.S.C. § 1045(a), (b)(3)).
caveat: Election mechanics, the replacement stock's own active-business qualification, holding-period tacking, and partnership-level rules are facts and law this repo does not compute — the rollover is explained and cited, never calculated here.
